svg.title: Diffusion training learns a direction through controlled corruption
svg.text: Diffusion training learns a direction through controlled corruption
Known signal and Gaussian-noise coefficients create a statistical estimation task
x(t) = sqrt(alpha_bar(t)) x0 + sqrt(1 - alpha_bar(t)) noise
Learn εθ(x(t),t): the conditional expected noise under squared error
The picture is a synthetic visual analogy, not samples from an executed diffusion model.
The training marginal can be sampled directly at t; no full forward simulation is necessary.
The predictor type and schedule coefficients define the reverse-sampling numerical interface.
